tables.grain: One current truck-master row per unique truck number.
One current driver-master profile. Field-level Z mappings are Unknown in the kit.
One truck identifier or owner bucket per Tuesday–Monday settlement period.
One historic fuel transaction. The kit does not declare an explicit Ninox table ID.

joinRules: DriverPay.DriversDB_ID is text while drivers.Ninox_ID is numeric. In SQL use DriverPay.DriversDB_ID = drivers.Ninox_ID::text.
Historical truck keys in DriverPay, returns, and settlements are text while trucks.truck_number is numeric. Normalize before comparing.
Use a LEFT JOIN from historical tables to the current trucks master. An inner join silently drops valid history.
returns.Ninox_ID identifies the Returns source record and is not a driver ID. Do not join it to drivers.Ninox_ID.
CDL is the unique driver key across drivers and DriverPay. Truck number is the vehicle key across documented field variants.
returns.CDL is a sensitive exact driver key; use it only when it matches a verified CDL in related approved data. Do not substitute a name, Supabase ID, or returns.Ninox_ID.
fuel.Unit is a numeric historic truck identifier. Normalize and LEFT JOIN to trucks.truck_number. The kit does not declare a Ninox table ID for fuel.
LTL_Shop identifies vehicles by truckNumber. That is a business-key match to kit trucks.truck_number / Ninox E.A, not a Ninox ref/rev edge.
notes: These mappings are external reporting-kit evidence, not Ninox ref/rev metadata.
metadata.ts SCHEMA_VERSION remains 3.2.0 (verified 2026-09-14). Kit changelog HEAD is 3.8.23 (2026-09-17) and does not add new explicit Ninox table IDs.
DriverPay.Truck_Number is documented as Ninox WD.IA in kit meaning and data-dictionary, but metadata.ts does not set ninox_field, so catalog:import still ignores it.
settlements.tonu is only a related Ninox concept (DE.M1 / Facturado Compass), not an explicit ninox_field mapping.
mechanic_status (E.TA) is the kit's current shop-status field on TrucksDB. LTL_Shop yard status is a Work Plan / YardBoardPhase, not that Ninox field.
Schedule_Teams is a live Ninox share used by reporting, not a mapped table ID in metadata.ts.
Settlement Trucks 1/2/3 are owner-expense allocation labels in Facturacion, not separate Ninox tables.
